selection: Piecewise-constant authored periods with an explicit 1995 structural-shock period plus later recovery anchors; legal/constitutional events remain context only.
limitations: All numeric ratings are project estimates with low confidence, not source measurements.
UK-wide sports evidence is not inherited automatically.
No tennis federation membership or organised competition is inferred.
Legal, constitutional and disaster events are context inputs only, not direct sports-performance measurements.
No rankings, titles or athlete outcomes are used to fit ratings.
